author: KEXP
description:
Seville-born artist La Tremendita fuses flamenco tradition with electronica, funk, and jazz. Our latest Live on KEXP session in Bilbao shares a charged performance of "Esperanza" and more from across her discography. 

Watch the full session and interview on our listener-powered YouTube channel.
title: La Tremendita performs "Esperanza" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
